justification: Changes the clause numbers three live APIs serve (browse/section, clause/[id], cross-references). Not Critical: it only removes an unproven number and keeps the page and wording. Not Minor: it changes served regulatory citations.

pre_impl.existing_data: citation_status (migration 076) already written for all served DCP rows; withServedCitation already exists (#1170). Reused, no new helper.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The resume plan listed dcp-complete, dcp/*, provisions/[id]/*; grep of page imports showed those feed only ComplianceDashboard/V2, which no page imports. The live screens are /dcp-browse, quick search and the cross-reference link, so those routes were changed.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Read-only: two columns added to three SELECTs.
pre_impl.external_source_error: clause/[id] reads the canonical view, which lacks citation_status; LEFT JOIN on regulatory_provisions by id. A missing join row gives NULL status and no council, served as before (LEP/SEPP behaviour).
pre_impl.frontend_type: refNumber and targetReference become string|null; ProvisionDisplay renders the label only when present; LegalTextPanel already guarded targetReference; clause_reference falls back to 'Provision <id>'.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A true number wrongly judged unproven is hidden, the page still shown: the citation stays true. 1,864 current non-actionable council rows are unchecked (NULL) and now show no number on /dcp-browse (fail closed, as #1170).

falsifiable_check.fails_when: any of the three routes serves the stored number of a not_proven council row
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Mutation: replacing withServedCitation with a pass-through in each route in turn fails 1 test each (3/3 killed).

functions.name: GET/POST handlers (browse/section, clause/[id], cross-references)
functions.input: DB rows with ref_number, provision_text, citation_status, source_council
functions.output: the served label (refNumber / clause_reference / targetReference) null or 'Provision <id>' and the stored code stripped from the first line unless proven or imprecise

queries.where_clause: document_id = $1 AND is_current AND pdf_page in section range (unchanged)
rp.id = $1 (unchanged), LEFT JOIN regulatory_provisions live ON live.id = rp.id

break_it.scenario: Browse section rows include current but non-actionable council rows, which the status writer never judges (NULL)
break_it.what_happens: their stored numbers would be served unchecked
break_it.how: NULL status with a source_council fails closed in citationIsShown; 1,864 such rows now show no number, page kept
break_it.repro: SELECT count(*) FROM regulatory_provisions WHERE is_current AND source_council IS NOT NULL AND citation_status IS NULL  -- 1864 on 2026-09-26

break_it.scenario: Target provision of a cross reference is missing (LEFT JOIN null)
break_it.what_happens: the joined status and council columns are both NULL
break_it.how: treated as non-DCP: targetReference null anyway, targetText null
break_it.repro: withServedCitation with all-null fields returns clause_label null

break_it.what_happens: a statewide clause must keep its printed number
break_it.how: NULL status with no source_council is shown
break_it.repro: jest: 'serves an LEP/SEPP row (no council) as before'

post_merge.manual_verify: Open /dcp-browse on a Woollahra chapter and confirm not_proven rules show a page but no clause code.
